guideline: A 6-point scale assessing grammar, vocabulary, style, and clarity of meaning.
Annotators rate each generated sentence on a 6‑point scale (0–5) describing overall quality, including grammar, vocabulary, style and understandability.

• 0=Exceptionally poor (No useful information is conveyed at all.) • 1=Poor (Fundamental errors in grammar and vocabulary make it difficult to understand the meaning.) • 2=Not good enough (Errors in grammar, vocabulary and style make it difficult to understand the meaning.) • 3=Good enough (There are errors in the text, but I am reasonably confident that I understand the meaning.) • 4=Very good (There may be minor errors in the text, but I am very confident that I understand the meaning.) • 5=Excellent (The information is presented clearly and with appropriate grammar, vocabulary and style.)
